response.sql:
WITH media_type_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    MediaTypeId,
    AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price,
    AVG(CAST(Bytes AS NUMERIC) / CAST(Milliseconds AS NUMERIC)) AS bytes_per_ms
  FROM Track
  WHERE Bytes IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY MediaTypeId
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) AS overall_bytes_per_ms
  FROM media_type_stats
),
filtered AS (
  SELECT m.avg_unit_price, m.bytes_per_ms
  FROM media_type_stats m, overall_avg o
  WHERE m.bytes_per_ms > o.overall_bytes_per_ms
)
SELECT
  AVG(f.avg_unit_price) AS avg_of_avg_unit_prices,
  AVG(f.bytes_per_ms) AS avg_of_bytes_per_ms,
  AVG(f.bytes_per_ms) - o.overall_bytes_per_ms AS avg_rate_above_overall
FROM filtered f, overall_avg o;

assumptions.assumption: For each media type, 'bytes per millisecond' is the unweighted average of per-track ratios: AVG(Bytes / Milliseconds). This treats each track equally, rather than weighting by track length.

alternatives.interpretation: For each media type, 'bytes per millisecond' is the aggregated rate SUM(Bytes) / SUM(Milliseconds), weighting longer tracks more heavily.
